items.result: ACCEPTED by owner decision as RELAYED by agent-509 (2026-10-22; agent-drafted wording, not owner-confirmed). Component-side fit (the J1 basis): for ordinary soldered through-hole parts the owner uses at least +/-10% of the manufacturer's recommended nominal board thickness as an inclusive fit-screening default, often wider (AGENTEE-448). For J1, TE's recommended 1.57 mm (K1 sheet 2 layout title) gives 1.413-1.727 mm; the 1.6 mm nominal board is inside (about 1.9% from nominal), so J1 screens as fitting. Explicit manufacturer functional limits would override; outside the band alone is advisory, not a defect. Board side, separately: the pod board is the standard JLCPCB four-layer 1.6 mm board, accepted with JLCPCB's published +/-10% finished-thickness tolerance (1.44-1.76 mm); that fabricator tolerance is not the component-fit basis and the two are not conflated. J1 1-776163-1 is a through-hole soldered header with a mechanical retention pin; its leads are trimmed after soldering (seat, tack one pin, re-seat/align, solder the rest, trim excess stickout). Interval arithmetic between fab and TE tolerances is not an actionable release uncertainty. No special tolerance, TE confirmation, enclosure CAD or owner harness is required for placement, routing or bare-board fab readiness. A narrower requirement needs a concrete source or an observed failure.

evidence.fact: owner-relayed (agent-drafted, unconfirmed): component-side through-hole fit screen of at least +/-10% around the manufacturer's recommended nominal (J1: TE 1.57 mm, band 1.413-1.727 mm, 1.6 mm inside); separately, the standard JLCPCB four-layer 1.6 mm board is accepted with its published finished tolerance as a board-side fact; TE's 1.57 mm is not a thickness gate; leads are trimmed after soldering; normal footprint, finished-hole/pad, retention and solder-joint checks remain

The table is unlabelled; 'TABLE 1' on sheet 1 is the terminal/wire-size table. E5 lists the 776163 family, not the 1-776163-1 dash number; the color pairing comes from E5 note 2 and K1. E2 is kept as historical and is not rewritten.

lead_claims.claim: check customer drawing K1 if the spec's priority clause names it
lead_claims.finding: S3 section 2.3 names no drawing. The K1 in the drop is byte-identical to the existing capture.

board_side_checks.check: J1 footprint PodConnector:AMPSEAL_35_1-776163-1 (../PodConnector.pretty/AMPSEAL_35_1-776163-1.kicad_mod) against S3 Figure 13a and the K1 sheet 2 PCB layout, nominal
board_side_checks.detail: 35 plated holes with drill 1.75 (S3 page 9: diameter 1.75 +/-0.1 after plating; K1 sheet 2: 1.75 AFTER PLATING) and 2.4 mm pads (pad size is not specified by S3 or K1); 2 NPTH of 2.85 at local x +/-28.5, y +0.5 (S3: diameter 2.85 +/-0.08, 2 places, right-angle header only, Z = 57.0 for 35 positions); rows at y -4/0/+4 (row spacing 4) and the middle row 0.5 from the 2.85-hole center line (S3: 0.5); rows of 12 / 11 / 12 contacts at 4 mm pitch, the middle row offset 2 (S3: 4 and 2; 'Y Places' 11 and 'X Places' 35 for 35 positions), outer rows -22 to +22, 6.5 from the 2.85 holes to the first contact column (S3: 6.5). KiCad drill is taken as the finished-hole target; the fabricator's finished-hole tolerance is not checked here.

board_side_checks.check: board-lock / retention and solder-tail length against S3
board_side_checks.detail: S3 shows a 'Retention Leg' only as a Figure 1 label and gives no retention, board-lock or solder-tail dimension. S3 page 9 says the header suits standard wave soldering with tin solder. The K1 (3.0-4.0) tail reference and the trimming note in pcb_thickness.derived_observation stand unchanged.
